title: PincerPay x402 Facilitator
summary: Settle AI agent payments to merchants through an on-chain facilitator that takes a protocol fee and keeps a settlement record.
what: PincerPay is an x402 payment facilitator for agents. Its Anchor 0.30.1 program registers merchants, settles agent token payments with a fee, and records settlements that happened off chain by transaction hash.
app_note: The page at /dapps/pincerpay/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/pincerpay; only declare_id changed, and the lab binary is built with --arch v2.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/pincerpay/, switch to Devnet and read the config and merchant accounts.
try_steps.see: The fee_bps, settlement nonce and merchant totals.
try_steps.ran: The full merchant, settlement and fee flow (see steps).

diagram: authority --initialize(fee)--> config; authority --register_merchant--> merchant; agent+authority --settle_payment--> merchant ATA (+fee vault) + settlement record; authority --record_x402_settlement--> record; authority --withdraw_fees--> destination
innovation: The same settlement ledger covers payments settled on chain and x402 payments settled elsewhere, so a merchant has one auditable record.
exercises: Why does settle_payment need both the agent and the facilitator to sign?
How would you check that a recorded x402 hash is real?
